source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of transgenic bacteria (PDF 163).

blocks.text: Bohat se mukhtalif jandaron ke genes plasmid mein jor kar bacteria mein dale ja sakte hain. Transgenic bacteria in bahar se dale gaye (foreign) genes ke proteins bari miqdar mein bana sakte hain. Mukhtalif transgenic bacteria in kaamon ke liye istemal ho rahe hain:

items: Dawaen (pharmaceutical products) banana, maslan insulin (diabetes ke ilaaj ke liye), clotting factors (haemophilia ke ilaaj ke liye), hepatitis B vaccine (hepatitis B se bachao), Covid-19 vaccine (Corona se bachao), human growth hormone (bauna pan, dwarfism, ke ilaaj ke liye), interferon (kuch cancers ke ilaaj ke liye), erythropoietin (khoon ki kami, anaemia, ke ilaaj ke liye) aur tissue plasminogen activator (jo khoon ke lothre ghola deta hai).

Khane ki bohat si cheezein banana, maslan alpha-amylase (starch ko saada sugars mein badalta hai), chymosin (cheese banane ke liye doodh ke protein ko jamata hai) aur pectin-esterase (phalon ke juice ko saaf karta hai).
Aise enzymes banana jo zehreele maadde (toxins) tor kar aaloodgi (pollutants) ko kam zehreela bana dete hain.
Kachi dhaat (ore) se tamba (copper) nikalna, paare (mercury) ki aaloodgi saaf karna aur peene ke paani mein arsenic ka pata lagana.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Covid-19 ki zyada tar vaccines khud bacteria mein nahin banti; bacteria aksar mRNA vaccines ke liye DNA ke template (saanche) barhane mein kaam aate hain. Kitab ne ise transgenic bacteria ki misal ke taur par likha hai.

blocks.prompt: Transgenic bacteria se banne wali do dawaen aur un se hone wala ilaaj batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do, maslan insulin (diabetes), clotting factors (haemophilia), human growth hormone (dwarfism) ya erythropoietin (anaemia).

items: Transgenic bacteria plasmid mein dale gaye genes se bari miqdar mein proteins banate hain.
Istemal: dawaen, khane ke enzymes, toxins torne wale enzymes, copper nikalna, mercury saaf karna, arsenic pakarna.
